items.title: Dow Giant Walmart Sinks To A 9-Month Low Despite Earnings Beat-And-Raise
items.summary: Walmart raised guidance for the full year early Thursday after beating earnings and revenue estimates for its second quarter. But WMT stock plunged to a nine-month low. Walmart is the world's largest retailer by 2025 sales, according to the National Retail Federation.

items.title: Home Depot's Tariff Refund Never Made It To The Guide
